flags.why: Báo giới is formal vocabulary, so leaving it untagged suggests it is ordinary casual speech.
This form of address is mainly Southern Vietnamese.

Bằm meaning 'mince' is a Central and Southern regional form, as recorded in the [Huế dialect dictionary](https://khungcuahep.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/T%E1%BB%AB-%C4%90i%E1%BB%83n-Ph%C6%B0%C6%A1ng-Ng%E1%BB%AF-Hu%E1%BA%BF-Tr%E1%BA%A7n-Ng%E1%BB%8Dc-B%E1%BA%A3o.pdf).
The walking sense occurs in đi vã, not as a standalone verb in tôi vã ra chợ, as illustrated in the [dictionary entry](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-v%C3%A3).
flags.fix: Tôi phải đi vã hàng chục cây số để tới chợ. = I had to walk dozens of kilometres to reach the market.
